title: The Wild Thorn
author: Sebastian Nystrom
blurb: Isandro Pemberton, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
